memory_candidates.note: DerivationTree.axiom [] _ (...) trivial inside a let binding (not a directly expected-typed anonymous constructor) can strand the frame-class/index metavariable unresolved, causing `trivial : True` term-mode proofs to fail against an always-true but metavariable-headed goal. Fix: pin implicit index params explicitly (e.g. (fc := ...)) and supply concrete argument terms instead of `_` placeholders that are only unified by later usage.
